method: The archive's milestones as races, computed from data/v1/milestone-watch.json (bands + summit), data/artist.json (plays and upload dates), data/v1/milestones.json (crossed milestone dates), data/v1/session-clusters.json (session records), and data/v1/eras.json (era records). Race figures are simple snapshot arithmetic: current value, target, gap, and an at-pace figure that is pace-arithmetic, never a prediction.
pace_definition: pace_per_day = snapshot plays ÷ days from the track's upload date to the 2026-10-11 snapshot. A lifetime average, not a current rate. days_at_pace (plays still needed ÷ pace) and catch_days_at_pace (summit gap ÷ pace) are plain division - an honest arithmetic estimate, never a prediction.

head_to_head.method: Any two active play races, raced against each other. The projected finisher is whoever has the smaller days_at_pace - plain division on the 2026-10-11 snapshot, with the uncertainty stated on every pair. Races with different targets have different finish lines: the race is who gets there first, not who runs fastest. Pairs are ordered by days_gap ascending - the closest projected finishes first. The same project_pair arithmetic powers the page's race-any-two-tracks tool (from vault_pace, client-side).

race_history.method: Completed races from the archive's own records. threshold_winners counts vault tracks past each round-number play threshold and names the current leader - crossing dates are not recorded: the archive holds ONE play-count snapshot (2026-10-11), so crossing dates and finish order for these races cannot be recovered and are not claimed. completed_crossings are the dated milestone entries from data/v1/milestones.json (the undated 'Longest silence' entry is excluded, recorded here). The photo finish is the pair of recorded crossings closest together in time.

completed_crossings.name: Latest transmission
completed_crossings.title: turn up w me (prod_timmy)
completed_crossings.fact: The most recent upload on record. The archive is alive.

completed_crossings.name: 250,000 plays crossed
completed_crossings.title: 3 Points Pre Game prod. doublemulti x pinkcat #NITEMODE
completed_crossings.fact: Cumulative vault plays crossed a quarter-million with this upload, counted in upload order from the play-count snapshot.

completed_crossings.name: Most prolific day
completed_crossings.fact: 17 transmissions uploaded in a single day: the densest outpouring on record.

completed_crossings.name: 100th vault transmission
completed_crossings.title: I Can't Get Myself to Cast (prod. lil biscuit)
completed_crossings.fact: The SoundCloud vault's own 100th upload, mid-2021, deep in the Cast It: years.

completed_crossings.name: 100th transmission on record
completed_crossings.title: I'm Not Looking For Love Anyway
completed_crossings.fact: The catalog's 100th entry in chronological order, reached before the end of 2020.

completed_crossings.name: First collaboration
completed_crossings.title: Mistakes Ft. JO$E DRIPP (prod. Tec)
completed_crossings.fact: The first transmission to summon another voice. The circle starts here and grows to twenty-one collaborators.

completed_crossings.name: First vault transmission
completed_crossings.title: Soul Shaking (prod. Fish Narc)
completed_crossings.fact: The first upload to the official SoundCloud, and it arrived already carrying five figures of plays. The opening shot was not a warm-up.

completed_crossings.name: First distributor transmission
completed_crossings.title: lost memories (feat. Aster Da Master)
completed_crossings.fact: The catalog's first appearance on streaming platforms: as a featured artist, two years before the first vault upload.

photo_finish.note: The two recorded milestone crossings closest together in time - the archive's tightest back-to-back finish, as recorded. These are catalog milestones, not per-track crossing times.

race_of_the_week.basis: The closest active race at the 2026-10-11 snapshot: the shortest days_at_pace among the play races. Computed from the data, not chosen by an editor.
race_of_the_week.share_text: Race to watch: "master key ft. Lil Wintr x Marcelo (prod. ginseng)" is 385 plays from 10,000 plays (9,615 of 10,000 plays). At lifetime pace, ~100.3 days to the line - an estimate, not a prediction. Aster da Master milestone race.
race_of_the_week.caveat: Play counts are the 2026-10-11 snapshot; pace is a lifetime average from that single snapshot, not a current rate - the spotlight is arithmetic, never a prediction.

snapshot_provenance: The 2026-10-11 play-count snapshot was independently re-captured on 2026-10-11 by a read-only live-browser pass of the official SoundCloud profile (soundcloud.com/asterdamaster): all 185 tracks matched the archive's snapshot with zero play-count differences. Titles and play counts are factual metadata.
